lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg28Co2Sn2 (Mg14CoSn) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Sn each adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers show 12 neighbors in a higher coordination environment. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, alongside Mg–Co and Mg–Sn corner- and edge-sharing.
